templates.title: Headroom study
templates.desc: For each dispatch of generator A: a new study case, load flow, unit trip and RMS run; when the frequency settles, its nadir goes into a table.

templates.title: Load flow on every study case
templates.desc: Runs the load flow of every study case and tables the lowest and highest busbar voltage of each, with where they are.

templates.title: N-1 screening
templates.desc: Takes out each line and transformer in turn (base case first), runs the load flow and tables the highest loading and lowest voltage.

templates.title: Short circuit at every busbar
templates.desc: Runs an IEC 60909 maximum three-phase short circuit at each busbar in turn and tables Ikss and Skss, with a bar chart of the fault currents.

templates.title: Largest dispatch with a safe nadir
templates.desc: Searches the largest dispatch of generator A for which the frequency after a unit trip stays above the UFLS level, by halving the gap.

templates.title: Fault ride-through check
templates.desc: A 150 ms fault at the connection point: checks the voltage against an LVRT curve and the time the plant power takes to recover to 90 %.

templates.title: Critical clearing time
templates.desc: Searches the longest fault duration at a busbar for which the rotor angle spread of the generators stays below a limit, by halving the gap.
